basic_info.description:
Located in Russian Hill, near the border of Cow Hollow, this light-filled top-floor condo seamlessly blends timeless 1907 elements with modern updates. Features include: 

-Top floor 
-Open-concept living with abundant natural light
-Thoughtfully renovated kitchen 
-Two generously sized bedrooms are set apart from the main living areas 
-One remodeled full bathroom + a half bathroom 
-WiFi enabled thermostat 
-Period details such as boxed beam ceilings, intricate moldings, and classic craftsmanship 
-In-unit washer/dryer 
-One-car garage parking and storage included 

Life in Russian Hill is as iconic as San Francisco itself. With a Walk Score of 98, errands, dining, and entertainment are effortless on nearby Polk and Union Streets, making this quintessential San Francisco living. Tech Shuttle stops are only steps away on Van Ness. 

Lease Terms: 
-12+ month lease 
-Unfurnished 
-Water and trash included 
-Pets considered 
-Non-smoking unit 

SF City Rents
DRE# 02187202 (please don't use the DRE# to request a showing, instead please provide the property address: 1448 Filbert St.) 

This unit is a rental unit subject to the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, which limits evictions without just cause, and which states that any waiver by a tenant of their rights under the Rent Ordinance is void as contrary to public policy. This unit may not be subject to rent increase restrictions.
